metadata.question: Is the chlorophyll-a concentration higher in the southern coastal waters of Java (-8.879787, 110.2273416) compared to the northern Java Sea waters (-5.741852, 109.953683) on August 4, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 MultiSpectral Instrument (MSI) Level-2A for turbidity index as proxy for chlorophyll-a. Date: 2019-08-04, window ±1 week. Location: two off-shore, deep-water pixels near Java (one south of Java island, one in Java Sea). 2. Masking: Use the built-in SCL layer to pick open-water (class = 6) and discard clouds/shadows (classes 3,8,9,10) for the turbidity index (NIR/Red ratio). 3. Logic: Compute mean turbidity index (NIR/Red ratio, inverted). If any site has 0 valid water pixels, output C2. If image collection sizes are zero, output C1. If computed result is None/NaN, output C3. Compare mean values and output A (south higher) or B otherwise. import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') p_s = ee.Geometry.Point([110.2273416, -8.879787]) # south Java coastal p_n = ee.Geometry.Point([109.9536830, -5.741852]) # Java Sea def get_water_ratio(pt, d0): c = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') .filterDate(ee.Date(d0).advance(-3,'day'), ee.Date(d0).advance(3,'day')) .filterBounds(pt).filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE',50))) if c.size().getInfo()==0: return None,0 s = c.first().clip(pt.buffer(150)) water = s.select('SCL').eq(6) valid = s.updateMask(water) ratio = valid.select('B8').divide(valid.select('B4')) cnt = ratio.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=pt,scale=100,maxPixels=1e9).get('B8').getInfo() val = ratio.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt,scale=100,maxPixels=1e9).get('B8').getInfo() return val,cnt valS,cntS = get_water_ratio(p_s,'2019-08-04') valN,cntN = get_water_ratio(p_n,'2019-08-04') print(f"South Java ratio: {valS}, Pixels: {cntS}") print(f"North Java ratio: {valN}, Pixels: {cntN}") if any(v is None for v in (valS,valN)): print("C1") elif cntS==0 or cntN==0: print("C2") elif any(v<0 or v>5 for v in (valS,valN)): print("C3") else: print("A" if valS>valN else "B")
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

p_s = ee.Geometry.Point([110.2273416, -8.879787])  # south Java coastal
p_n = ee.Geometry.Point([109.9536830, -5.741852])  # Java Sea

def get_water_ratio(pt, d0):
    c = (ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
           .filterDate(ee.Date(d0).advance(-3,'day'), ee.Date(d0).advance(3,'day'))
           .filterBounds(pt).filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE',50)))
    if c.size().getInfo()==0: return None,0
    s = c.first().clip(pt.buffer(150))
    water = s.select('SCL').eq(6)
    valid = s.updateMask(water)
    ratio = valid.select('B8').divide(valid.select('B4'))
    cnt = ratio.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                             geometry=pt,scale=100,maxPixels=1e9).get('B8').getInfo()
    val = ratio.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                             geometry=pt,scale=100,maxPixels=1e9).get('B8').getInfo()
    return val,cnt

valS,cntS = get_water_ratio(p_s,'2019-08-04')
valN,cntN = get_water_ratio(p_n,'2019-08-04')

print(f"South Java ratio: {valS}, Pixels: {cntS}")
print(f"North Java ratio: {valN}, Pixels: {cntN}")

if any(v is None for v in (valS,valN)):
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif cntS==0 or cntN==0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif any(v<0 or v>5 for v in (valS,valN)):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if valS>valN else "<answer>B</answer>")
